Rocket provides MV BASIC syntax and workflow context as GitHub Copilot custom instructions files that you can add to your project to improve GitHub Copilot's assistance with MV BASIC development and MVVS configuration. Use of these files requires GitHub Copilot to be separately installed and enabled under your own license. MVVS does not install, enable, or require GitHub Copilot, and MVVS features work the same whether or not you add these files. These files do not send source code, prompts, or usage data to Rocket or any third party. Your use of GitHub Copilot, including GitHub Copilot's handling of your code and prompts, is governed by GitHub Copilot's terms.
